question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**find**" is the most appropriate to use in this context.
 
• Charlie reads the book to "**find** out more" about the other kids, meaning to discover or learn additional information.
 
• "**Spot**" means to see or notice, which doesn’t fit as well in the context of learning more information.
 
• "**Locate**" means to find the exact position of something, which is less appropriate than the general discovery implied by** "find."**
 
• "**Unlearn**" means to discard previously learned information, which is incorrect here.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *But you have to read the book to find__ out more about them.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Spot**: To see or notice someone or something, which is not fitting in the context of discovering information.
 
• **Locate**: To discover the exact position of something, which is more specific and not as suitable here.
 
• **Unlearn**: To discard knowledge previously learned, which is not applicable in this context.
